en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of two prominent buildings set among trees and lawns. On the left is an ornate, multi-storey brick school building, and on the right stands a tall church with a pointed clock tower and steeple. The caption at the bottom of the image reads 'Sundsvall, Flickskolan och Kyrkan.' The reverse side features handwritten text and a green Swedish stamp denominated at 10 öre with 'SVERIGE' and a lion motif.
